words.note: 當 ticket 的重點是讓持有人獲准進入展覽、活動、景點或場館時，可用 admission pass。它比一般 ticket 更強調『獲准入場』這個功能。
words.example: Visitors must show an admission pass at the main entrance.
words.exampleZh: 訪客必須在正門出示入場證。

exercises.original: Each ticket allows one visitor to enter the exhibition for the afternoon session.
exercises.zh: 每張票可讓一名訪客進入下午場展覽。
exercises.upgrade: admission pass · 入場證；入場通行證

options.explanation: fare = 車資／票價。表示支付的價格，不是入場憑證。
admission pass = 入場證。allows one visitor to enter the exhibition 是最直接的入場功能。
receipt = 收據。證明已付款，不一定能作入場憑證。
reservation = 預約／訂位。保留名額，但不一定等於入場證。
boarding pass = 登機證／乘車登乘證。用於登上交通工具，不適合展覽。
coupon = 優惠券。通常用來獲折扣或兌換，不等於入場票。

exercises.original: The festival ticket must be shown at the entrance before guests can enter the main grounds.
exercises.zh: 賓客進入節慶主場地前，必須在入口出示入場證。
exercises.upgrade: admission pass · 入場證；入場通行證

options.explanation: booking confirmation = 預訂確認。可證明已預訂，但不一定就是入口憑證。
voucher = 兌換券。通常需兌換成票或服務。
fare = 車資／票價。不是實體或電子入場憑證。
travel ticket = 交通票。用於旅程，不是節慶場地。
admission pass = 入場證。shown at the entrance + enter the main grounds 是典型。
receipt = 收據。只證明付款。

exercises.original: Your ticket gives you access to the museum and the special evening exhibition.
exercises.zh: 你的票可讓你進入博物館和晚間特展。
exercises.upgrade: admission pass · 入場證；入場通行證

options.explanation: admission pass = 入場證。gives you access to the museum and exhibition 明確是入場權限。
fare = 票價。表示金額，不是憑證。
boarding pass = 登機證。交通場景才適合。
coupon = 優惠券。不能直接代表入場權。
receipt = 收據。不是入場權限文件。
travel card = 交通卡。無關博物館。

words.note: 當 ticket 更像需要在門口、檢查站或受管制區域出示的進入憑證時，可用 entry pass。它比 admission pass 更偏『通過入口／檢查點』。
words.example: Delegates receive an entry pass at registration.
words.exampleZh: 代表在登記時會收到一張入場通行證。

exercises.original: Each delegate receives a ticket at registration that must be shown at every security checkpoint.
exercises.zh: 每名代表登記時會收到一張通行證，並須在每個保安檢查點出示。
exercises.upgrade: entry pass · 進入許可證；通行證

options.explanation: fare = 費用。不是保安憑證。
receipt = 收據。只證明付款。
booking = 預訂。不是在檢查點反覆出示的通行證。
entry pass = 通行證。registration + every security checkpoint 是典型受管制進入語境。
e-ticket only = 電子票。描述格式，不一定代表安全通行權。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。

exercises.original: Staff were given special tickets to enter the backstage area through a controlled door.
exercises.zh: 工作人員獲發特別通行證，可經受管制的門進入後台區域。
exercises.upgrade: entry pass · 進入許可證；通行證

options.explanation: admission ticket = 入場票。較像觀眾的一次入場票，不如 entry pass 適合受管制後台。
fare = 票價。無關。
entry pass = 進入通行證。staff + backstage + controlled door 是非常清楚的權限憑證語境。
receipt = 收據。不能授權進入。
season ticket = 季票。用於多場活動，不是員工後台權限。
travel ticket = 交通票。無關。

exercises.original: The conference ticket is checked at the restricted entrance before participants enter the secure hall.
exercises.zh: 參加者進入受管制會場前，會在限制入口檢查通行證。
exercises.upgrade: entry pass · 進入許可證；通行證

options.explanation: boarding pass = 登乘證。適用交通工具。
admission ticket = 入場票。也可能，但 restricted entrance + secure hall 更突出 entry pass 的安全通行功能。
travel ticket = 交通票。無關。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。
receipt = 收據。無法授權進入。
entry pass = 通行證。restricted entrance + secure hall 是決定性線索。

words.note: pass 是很常見的廣義近義詞，可表示允許進入某地、參加活動或使用交通服務的憑證。它通常比 ticket 更強調『使用權／進入權』。
words.example: Keep your pass with you throughout the event.
words.exampleZh: 整個活動期間請隨身保留通行證。

exercises.original: Keep your ticket visible while you are inside the venue because staff may check it again.
exercises.zh: 在場館內請把通行證保持可見，因為職員可能再次檢查。
exercises.upgrade: pass · 通行證；入場證；乘車證

options.explanation: receipt = 收據。一般不需要在場館內持續展示。
booking = 預訂。不是實體進入憑證。
fare = 票價。無法展示。
coupon = 優惠券。通常只使用一次。
pass = 通行證。keep visible + staff may check again 很符合持續通行權。
fine = 罰款／罰單。是 ticket 的另一個意思，但完全不合本課入場語境。

exercises.original: The ski ticket lets visitors use all lifts on the mountain for the whole day.
exercises.zh: 這張滑雪通行證可讓訪客整天使用山上的所有纜車。
exercises.upgrade: pass · 通行證；入場證；乘車證

options.explanation: fare = 乘車費。不是整天使用多條纜車的權利憑證。
pass = 通行證。whole day + use all lifts 是典型 ski pass。
receipt = 收據。不是使用權。
reservation = 預訂。可能保留名額，但不等於使用所有纜車。
boarding pass = 登乘證。通常只對一次登乘有效。
coupon = 優惠券。不是全天使用憑證。

exercises.original: Employees must scan their ticket each time they enter the building.
exercises.zh: 員工每次進入大樓都必須掃描通行證。
exercises.upgrade: pass · 通行證；入場證；乘車證

options.explanation: pass = 通行證。employees + repeated building access 是典型 access pass 用法。
fare = 費用。無關。
admission ticket = 入場票。通常是活動／場館一次或特定時段入場。
receipt = 收據。不是門禁憑證。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。
travel ticket = 交通票。無關建築門禁。

words.note: 當 ticket 明確是為戲院、博物館、演唱會、展覽或其他活動支付入場費後取得的票，可用 admission ticket。它強調『付費入場』。
words.example: Admission tickets can be purchased online in advance.
words.exampleZh: 入場票可預先在網上購買。

exercises.original: You can buy a ticket online before visiting the exhibition.
exercises.zh: 參觀展覽前可以在網上購買入場票。
exercises.upgrade: admission ticket · 入場票；門票

options.explanation: fare = 車資／票價。不是展覽入場憑證。
booking only = 只是一項預訂。可能還需另取票。
receipt = 收據。不是入場票。
admission ticket = 入場票。buy online + visiting the exhibition 是典型。
boarding pass = 登乘證。交通用。
fine = 罰單。是 ticket 的另一個詞義，完全無關。

exercises.original: The concert ticket cost fifty dollars and was scanned at the arena entrance.
exercises.zh: 演唱會入場票售價五十元，並在場館入口掃描。
exercises.upgrade: admission ticket · 入場票；門票

options.explanation: travel ticket = 交通票。不是演唱會。
entry badge = 入場證章。可能用於會議，但不是付費 concert ticket 的標準說法。
admission ticket = 入場票。cost + scanned at arena entrance 明確是付費門票。
fare = 票價。fifty dollars 是 fare-like 金額，但 fare 不能被掃描。
receipt = 收據。證明付款但不是入場票。
coupon = 優惠券。不是演唱會門票。

exercises.original: Every ticket includes entry to the museum's permanent collection and one temporary exhibition.
exercises.zh: 每張入場票都包括常設展和一個臨時展覽的入場。
exercises.upgrade: admission ticket · 入場票；門票

options.explanation: receipt = 收據。不能本身定義可進哪些展區。
booking = 預訂。可能保留參觀時段，但不是票本身。
fare = 車資。無關。
travel pass = 交通通行證。無關博物館。
coupon = 優惠券。不是標準入場憑證。
admission ticket = 入場票。museum entry package 是典型。

words.note: 當 ticket 用於乘坐火車、巴士、渡輪或其他交通工具時，可用 travel ticket。它是較廣泛的交通類說法，不特指某一種運輸工具。
words.example: Keep your travel ticket until the end of the journey.
words.exampleZh: 旅程結束前請保留交通票。

exercises.original: Passengers must keep their ticket until they leave the railway station at their destination.
exercises.zh: 乘客到達目的地並離開車站前必須保留交通票。
exercises.upgrade: travel ticket · 交通票；旅行票

options.explanation: admission pass = 入場證。不是火車旅程票。
receipt = 收據。不能證明有效乘車權。
travel ticket = 交通票。passengers + railway station + destination 是典型。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。
season pass = 季票。除非是長期通勤證，原句沒有這個線索。
entry pass = 進入通行證。不是旅程本身的票。

exercises.original: The machine sells tickets for local trains, buses, and ferries.
exercises.zh: 這部機器售賣本地火車、巴士和渡輪交通票。
exercises.upgrade: travel tickets · 交通票；旅行票

options.explanation: admission tickets = 入場票。用於場館活動。
travel tickets = 交通票。trains, buses, ferries 都可涵蓋。
receipts = 收據。不是乘車權憑證。
coupons = 優惠券。無關。
entry passes = 通行證。不是交通旅程票。
fines = 罰款。完全不同。

exercises.original: He lost his ticket during the journey and had to explain the situation to the conductor.
exercises.zh: 他在旅途中遺失了交通票，只好向車長解釋情況。
exercises.upgrade: travel ticket · 交通票；旅行票

options.explanation: travel ticket = 交通票。journey + conductor 是最直接線索。
admission pass = 入場證。無關。
receipt = 收據。車長通常檢查的是有效車票。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。
reservation = 預訂。座位預訂不一定等於有效乘車票。
fine = 罰款／罰單。是另一個 ticket 詞義，與丟失車票不同。

words.note: 當 ticket 的功能是讓旅客通過登乘程序並上飛機（有時也可延伸到其他運輸情況）時，可用 boarding pass。它不是票價，也不一定等於最初購買的 travel ticket。
words.example: You must scan your boarding pass before entering the aircraft.
words.exampleZh: 登機前必須掃描登機證。

exercises.original: The airline ticket on her phone was scanned at the gate just before she boarded the plane.
exercises.zh: 她手機上的登機證在登機前於閘口被掃描。
exercises.upgrade: boarding pass · 登機證；登乘證

options.explanation: fare = 機票價格。不能被閘口掃描作登機。
booking confirmation = 訂位確認。可證明預訂，但通常登機時掃 boarding pass。
receipt = 收據。不是登機憑證。
entry pass = 通行證。太泛，不是航空標準術語。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。
boarding pass = 登機證。airline + gate + boarded the plane 是決定性線索。

exercises.original: Passengers should have their ticket ready when their boarding group is called.
exercises.zh: 叫到登機組別時，乘客應準備好登機證。
exercises.upgrade: boarding pass · 登機證；登乘證

options.explanation: fare = 票價。不是文件或二維碼。
receipt = 收據。不能登機。
boarding pass = 登機證。boarding group called 是航空登機的典型線索。
admission ticket = 入場票。不是上飛機。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。
season ticket = 季票。無關。

exercises.original: After checking in online, he downloaded his ticket showing the gate, seat number, and boarding group.
exercises.zh: 網上辦理登機後，他下載了顯示閘口、座位號和登機組別的登機證。
exercises.upgrade: boarding pass · 登機證；登乘證

options.explanation: booking receipt = 訂位收據。通常不顯示 boarding group 作登機憑證。
fare = 票價。不是文件。
travel voucher = 旅行代用券。通常用於兌換或抵扣。
entry pass = 通行證。太泛。
boarding pass = 登機證。check-in + gate + seat + boarding group 是完整標準資訊。
admission pass = 入場證。不是航空用語。

words.note: 當 ticket 的重點是以電子形式發出、儲存在手機或電郵中，並以 QR code 或 barcode 出示時，可用 e-ticket。它描述的是票的形式，而不是用途。
words.example: Your e-ticket will be emailed to you after payment.
words.exampleZh: 付款後電子票會以電郵寄給你。

exercises.original: Your ticket will be sent by email as a QR code, so you do not need to print anything.
exercises.zh: 你的電子票會以 QR code 經電郵寄出，因此不用列印。
exercises.upgrade: e-ticket · 電子票；電子門票

options.explanation: receipt = 收據。可以電郵寄出，但不一定能入場或乘車。
e-ticket = 電子票。email + QR code + no printing 是最直接線索。
fare = 票價。不是數碼票。
paper ticket = 紙票。和 no need to print 相反。
coupon = 優惠券。不是票。
reservation only = 只是預訂。未必包含有效票證。

exercises.original: She saved the concert ticket in her phone's wallet app and scanned it at the entrance.
exercises.zh: 她把演唱會電子票儲存在手機錢包程式，並在入口掃描。
exercises.upgrade: e-ticket · 電子票；電子門票

options.explanation: e-ticket = 電子票。phone wallet + scanned at entrance 是典型。
receipt = 收據。不能直接入場。
fare = 票價。無法儲存在 wallet 作掃描入場。
paper pass = 紙本通行證。和 phone wallet 不符。
fine = 罰單。完全不同。
voucher only = 只是一張兌換券。通常還需兌換。

exercises.original: The theatre no longer mails physical tickets; customers receive them electronically after booking.
exercises.zh: 劇院不再郵寄實體票；顧客預訂後會收到電子票。
exercises.upgrade: e-tickets · 電子票；電子門票

options.explanation: boarding passes = 登乘證。劇院無關。
receipts = 收據。付款後可能收到，但不是劇院門票本身。
entry badges = 入場證章。通常用於會議或工作人員。
fares = 票價。是金額，不是票件。
coupons = 優惠券。無關。
e-tickets = 電子票。contrasted with physical tickets + received electronically 是決定性線索。

words.note: 當 ticket 允許持有人在同一天內多次或不限次數使用某設施、交通系統或景點時，可用 day pass。它比一般單次 ticket 提供更長的當日使用權。
words.example: A day pass gives unlimited access to the metro until midnight.
words.exampleZh: 一日通行證可讓你在午夜前無限次乘搭地鐵。

exercises.original: This ticket lets visitors enter the theme park as many times as they like until closing time today.
exercises.zh: 這張全日票讓訪客今天閉園前可不限次數進出主題公園。
exercises.upgrade: day pass · 一日通行證；全日票

options.explanation: single ticket = 單次票。和 as many times as they like 相反。
fare = 票價。不是使用權憑證。
receipt = 收據。不是進出權。
coupon = 優惠券。不能代表不限次數入場。
day pass = 一日通行證。unlimited re-entry + today until closing 是典型。
boarding pass = 登乘證。只供特定登乘。

exercises.original: Tourists can buy one ticket that covers unlimited bus travel for the entire day.
exercises.zh: 遊客可以買一張全日票，在整天內不限次數乘搭巴士。
exercises.upgrade: day pass · 一日通行證；全日票

options.explanation: day pass = 一日通行證。unlimited bus travel + entire day 是直接定義。
boarding pass = 登乘證。通常只供一次特定班次。
receipt = 收據。無乘車權。
reservation = 預訂。不是不限次數乘車。
admission ticket = 入場票。不是巴士交通。
fare = 車資。表示價格，不是不限次數使用憑證。

exercises.original: The spa ticket includes repeated access to the pools and sauna from morning until evening.
exercises.zh: 這張水療全日票包括由早到晚不限次數使用泳池和桑拿。
exercises.upgrade: day pass · 一日通行證；全日票

options.explanation: receipt = 收據。不是使用設施的憑證。
coupon = 優惠券。通常只帶折扣或兌換。
day pass = 全日通行證。repeated access + morning until evening 是典型。
single-entry ticket = 單次入場票。和 repeated access 相反。
fare = 交通費。無關。
boarding pass = 登乘證。無關。

words.note: 當 ticket 讓持有人在整個賽季、演出季或一段長期期間內多次入場時，可用 season ticket。常見於足球、棒球、劇院和表演藝術。
words.example: Season-ticket holders can attend every home game.
words.exampleZh: 季票持有人可觀看每場主場比賽。

exercises.original: His ticket gives him admission to every home game throughout the football season.
exercises.zh: 他的季票讓他整個足球賽季都可入場觀看每場主場比賽。
exercises.upgrade: season ticket · 季票；全季通行票

options.explanation: single ticket = 單場票。不能涵蓋 every home game。
fare = 票價。不是長期入場權。
boarding pass = 登乘證。交通用。
receipt = 收據。不是入場權。
coupon = 優惠券。無關。
season ticket = 季票。every home game + throughout the season 是最直接線索。

exercises.original: She renewed her theatre ticket so she could attend all six productions in the new season.
exercises.zh: 她續購劇院季票，以便觀看新一季全部六齣製作。
exercises.upgrade: season ticket · 季票；全季通行票

options.explanation: day pass = 一日票。只有效一天。
admission ticket only = 單次入場票。不能涵蓋 all six productions。
season ticket = 季票。renewed + all productions + new season 是典型劇院用法。
travel ticket = 交通票。無關。
receipt = 收據。無關。
fare = 票價。無關。

exercises.original: A ticket for the whole basketball season costs less than buying seats separately for every game.
exercises.zh: 整個籃球賽季的季票，比每場比賽分開買票便宜。
exercises.upgrade: season ticket · 季票；全季通行票

options.explanation: season ticket = 季票。whole season + every game 是直接定義。
single-entry pass = 單次通行證。和整季相反。
boarding pass = 登乘證。交通用。
day pass = 一日票。時間範圍太短。
receipt = 收據。不是入場權。
fare = 票價。不是整季憑證。

falseSynonyms.zh: 車資；船費；交通票價不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） fare 是乘坐交通工具所支付的價格，不是 ticket 這張憑證本身。你可以 pay a fare and receive/use a ticket。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The fare is the price; the ticket is the travel credential.

falseSynonyms.zh: 收據不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） receipt 證明你已付款，但通常不等於讓你入場或乘車的有效票。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A receipt proves payment; a ticket grants travel or admission.

falseSynonyms.zh: 預訂；訂位不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） reservation 代表名額或座位已被保留，但有些系統仍需要另行出票或取得 boarding pass。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A reservation holds a place; a ticket authorises the journey or admission.

falseSynonyms.zh: 預訂確認不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） booking confirmation 是預訂成功的證明，不一定可以直接用來入場或登乘。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A booking confirmation may come before the actual ticket.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兌換券；代用券不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） voucher 通常要用來兌換商品、服務或正式票券，因此不是一般 ticket 的直接同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A voucher may be exchanged for a ticket or service.

falseSynonyms.zh: 優惠券不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） coupon 主要用於折扣、優惠或兌換，不是一般入場或乘車票。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A coupon reduces a price or redeems an offer; it is not normally the ticket.

falseSynonyms.zh: 罰款；罰單不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） ticket 在交通違例語境可以指罰單，但 fine 是應付的罰款金額；而本課聚焦入場／交通憑證，兩者不能混用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A parking ticket may require you to pay a fine.

falseSynonyms.zh: 代幣；代用物不等於本課的 ticket（票券／憑證） 某些舊式交通系統會用 token 代替票，但 token 是付款／進入媒介的一種，不是現代 ticket 的一般同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A token can sometimes replace a ticket, but the terms are not generally interchangeable.
